response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country,'') AS country, CAST(v.points_won AS REAL)/v.points_max AS ratio FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0 AND v.points_won IS NOT NULL), c AS (SELECT country, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM r GROUP BY country) SELECT country, avg_ratio, avg_ratio / (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM c) AS ratio_to_mean_of_country_avgs FROM c

assumptions.assumption: 'Award-vote record' means rows in player_award_vote. manager_award_vote has a player_id but no foreign key to player, and the request does not name it.
A blank death country covers both NULL and empty string, and both go into one '' group.
A ratio can't be computed when points_max is NULL or 0, or points_won is NULL. Those votes are dropped, so a country with no computable ratios does not appear.
The mean of country averages is the unweighted mean of the per-country averages over all countries returned, including the blank group.

alternatives.interpretation: Use both player_award_vote and manager_award_vote as the award-vote records, combined into one set before grouping.
alternatives.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max FROM player_award_vote UNION ALL SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max FROM manager_award_vote), r AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country,'') AS country, CAST(v.points_won AS REAL)/v.points_max AS ratio FROM v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0 AND v.points_won IS NOT NULL), c AS (SELECT country, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM r GROUP BY country) SELECT country, avg_ratio, avg_ratio / (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM c) AS ratio_to_mean_of_country_avgs FROM c
